outcomes.text: Identify, read, write and count the numbers 0 to 9, and see 0 as a number.
Match numbers to objects, count backward, and put 0-9 in order.
Say which number comes before, after or between others up to 9.
Read, write and count numbers up to 99, and know 10 and 100.
Recognise tens and ones place value in two-digit numbers.
Compare and order numbers to 99 and find missing numbers in a sequence.
Use ordinal numbers first to tenth to show position.
Compare groups using one-to-one matching and the words more than and less than.
Use + and = and find how much more one number is than another up to 20.
Add one- and two-digit numbers without carrying, and complete missing-number equations.
Add mentally and write addition equations from pictures.
Use the subtraction sign and find how much smaller one number is.
Subtract one- and two-digit numbers without borrowing and fill missing-number equations.
Subtract mentally and write subtraction equations from pictures.

units.title: Unit 3: Measurement of Length and Mass

outcomes.text: Compare objects as long, short, tall, high, heavy or light with comparative and superlative words.
Identify Pakistani coins (Rs 1, 2, 5) and notes (Rs 10, 20, 50, 100).
Match groups of coins and notes of equal value and add and subtract using prices.
Make change up to 100, decide if money is enough for a purchase and add coin combinations.
Name the hour and minute hands and tell time in whole hours on analog and digital clocks.
Name the days of the week in order and the day before or after another.
Name the solar months.
Recognise and match rectangle, square, circle, oval and triangle in real objects.
Identify, describe and extend patterns of two or three elements.
Describe position: inside/outside, above/below, over/under, far/near, before/after, right/left.

topics.title: Ordinal numbers and numbers in words

subtopics.title: Ordinal numbers and numbers in words

outcomes.text: Write ordinal numbers first to twentieth and numbers 1-100 in words.
Read, write and compare numbers to 999 using hundreds, tens and ones.
Order numbers, count in tens and hundreds, and know 1000 follows 999.
Recognise fractions as equal parts, including half, one third and quarter, and write them as numerals.
Shade fractions of figures and name unit fractions and fractions like two thirds.
Add 2-digit numbers with carrying and solve real-life problems.
Add 3-digit numbers with and without carrying and solve problems.
Verify the commutative property of addition.
Subtract 2-digit and 3-digit numbers with and without borrowing and solve problems.
Solve mixed addition and subtraction problems.
Use the multiplication sign and see multiplication as repeated addition.
Build the tables of 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10, multiply within them and verify commutativity.
Solve real-life multiplication problems.
Use the division sign and see division as successive subtraction.
Divide within the tables with zero remainder and solve problems.
Solve real-life problems with all four operations, including Pakistani currency.

units.title: Unit 3: Measurement of Length, Mass and Capacity

outcomes.text: Know metre and centimetre, read and write their abbreviations, measure with a ruler and solve problems.
Know kilogram and gram, write their abbreviations and solve mass problems.
Compare capacities, use the litre and its abbreviation, and solve capacity problems.
Know hours in a day and minutes in an hour; read, write and draw clock time in five-minute steps.
Recognise a.m. and p.m. and use solar and lunar calendars to find dates.
Identify square, rectangle, triangle, circle, semi-circle and quarter-circle, and the vertices and sides of triangles and rectangles.
Tell straight lines from curved lines and draw a straight line with a ruler.
Read and write Roman numbers up to 20.
Identify and write even and odd numbers up to 99.
Find place values to six digits and read and write numbers to 100,000 in numerals and words.

topics.title: Comparing, ordering and the number line

subtopics.title: Comparing, ordering and the number line

outcomes.text: Compare numbers with <, > and =, and order sets of numbers.
Show a number on a number line and read a number from it.
Add and subtract numbers up to four digits, with and without carrying or borrowing, vertically and horizontally.
Add and subtract mentally up to 100 and solve real-life problems.
Use the term product and build tables of 6, 7, 8 and 9.
Multiply 2-digit by 1-digit numbers, multiply by zero, use mental strategies and solve problems.
Divide 2-digit by 1-digit numbers with zero remainder, use mental strategies and solve problems.
Write fractions in figures and match them with pictures.
Identify and write equivalent fractions.
Tell proper from improper fractions.
Compare fractions with the same denominator.
Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator, also through figures.

units.title: Unit 4: Measurement of Length, Mass and Capacity

outcomes.text: Read, measure and write km, m and cm.
Add and subtract lengths in the same units and solve problems.
Read, measure and write kg and g.
Add and subtract masses in the same units and solve problems.
Read, measure and write litre and millilitre.
Add and subtract volumes in the same units and solve problems.
Use a.m. and p.m., read analog and digital clocks and read days and dates on a calendar.
Add and subtract hours of time and solve problems.
Recognise point, line segment and ray; classify quadrilaterals and triangles; know circle, radius and diameter.
Calculate perimeters of squares, rectangles and triangles.
Read and interpret a picture graph.

topics.title: Numbers up to one hundred million

subtopics.title: Numbers up to one hundred million

outcomes.text: Find place values, read, write and compare numbers up to 8 digits, in numerals and words.
Add and subtract numbers up to 6 digits and solve real-life problems.
Multiply up to 5-digit by 3-digit numbers and divide up to 4-digit by 2-digit numbers.
Solve problems with all four operations, including Pakistani currency.
Know and use divisibility rules for 2, 3, 5 and 10 on numbers up to 5 digits.
Define and tell prime from composite numbers.
List factors up to 50 and the first twelve multiples, and tell factors from multiples.
Factorize a number into primes.
Find HCF by Venn diagram and prime factorization, and solve problems.
Find LCM by common multiples and prime factorization, and solve problems.
Define a fraction; tell like from unlike fractions.
Compare unlike fractions, order them and simplify to lowest form.
Identify unit, proper, improper and mixed fractions and convert between improper and mixed.
Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators.
Verify commutative and associative properties of addition.
Multiply fractions by whole numbers and by fractions; verify commutative and associative properties.
Divide fractions by whole numbers, whole numbers by fractions and fractions by fractions.
Solve real-life problems with fractions.
See decimals as fractions with denominator 10 or a power of 10 and find decimal place values.
Convert fractions to decimals and decimals up to three places to fractions.
Add and subtract decimals; multiply by 10, 100, 1000 and by a 2-digit number; divide by a 1-digit number.
Solve real-life problems with decimals.
Convert km, m, cm and mm; add and subtract lengths and choose units; solve problems.
Convert kg to g; add and subtract masses; choose units and solve problems.
Convert litres to millilitres; add and subtract volumes; solve problems.
Read hours, minutes and seconds and convert units of time.
Add and subtract time and solve real-life problems.
Know geometry box instruments and the use of H and HB pencils.
Measure and draw straight and curved lines.
Recognise horizontal, vertical, parallel and non-parallel lines; draw parallels with set squares.
Recognise an angle and its notation; right, acute and obtuse angles.
Know a degree and measure angles with a protractor.
Draw right, acute and obtuse angles, and angles equal, double or the sum of given angles.
Identify centre, radius, diameter and circumference and draw a circle with compasses.
Construct squares and rectangles with given sides.
Read and interpret horizontal and vertical bar graphs.
Read and interpret a line graph.
Read and write numbers up to one billion in numerals and words.
Add and subtract numbers of any size.
Multiply and divide up to 6-digit numbers by 10, 100, 1000, and 2- and 3-digit numbers; solve mixed problems.
Use BODMAS with parentheses and verify distributive laws.

topics.title: HCF and LCM of several numbers

subtopics.title: HCF and LCM of several numbers

outcomes.text: Find HCF of three numbers by prime factorization and division.
Find LCM of four numbers by the same methods and solve problems.
Add and subtract two or more fractions with different denominators.
Multiply a fraction by a number and by fractions, including brackets and mixed numbers; verify distributive laws.
Solve real-life multiplication problems.
Divide fractions by numbers and by fractions and solve problems.
Simplify expressions with fractions using BODMAS.
Add and subtract decimals; tell like from unlike decimals.
Multiply and divide decimals by powers of ten, whole numbers and decimals.
Change fractions to decimals by division; simplify bracketed expressions; round decimals.
Convert fractions and decimals both ways and solve problems.
See percentage as a special fraction; convert to fractions and decimals and solve problems.
Convert km, m, cm, mm both ways; add and subtract distances and solve problems.
Convert hours, minutes, seconds, years, months, weeks and days; add and subtract time.
Recognise Fahrenheit and Celsius and solve temperature problems.
Use the unitary method to find the value of many objects from one.
Define ratio; tell direct from inverse proportion and solve problems by unitary method.
Recognise acute, right, obtuse, straight and reflex angles; construct them with a protractor.
Describe adjacent, complementary and supplementary angles.
Define triangles by sides and by angles and name the hypotenuse.
Construct triangles from three sides, from two angles and the included side, or from one angle and adjacent sides.
Recognise square, rectangle, parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium and kite, and construct squares and rectangles.
Tell perimeter from area and know their units.
Use formulas for squares and rectangles and solve problems.
Define and find an average (mean) and solve real-life problems.
Draw block or column graphs, read and interpret bar graphs, and organise data.
Define a set, its notation and elements, and write a set in tabular form.
Define finite, infinite, empty, singleton, equal, equivalent sets, subsets, supersets, and proper and improper subsets.
Tell natural from whole numbers and show lists, inequalities and sums on a number line.
Add and subtract whole numbers; verify commutative and associative laws and 0 as additive identity.
Multiply and divide whole numbers; verify commutativity, associativity and 1 as multiplicative identity.
Verify the distributive law over addition and subtraction.
Define factor, multiple, even, odd, prime and composite numbers.
Know 1 is neither prime nor composite, 1 is a factor of all numbers, and 2 is the only even prime.
Test divisibility by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15 and 25.
Factorize numbers into primes and write factors in index notation.
Find HCF and LCM by prime factorization and by long division or division method.
Solve real-life problems with HCF and LCM.
Know positive and negative integers and zero, and show integers on a number line.
Compare and order integers.
Define absolute value as distance from zero and order absolute values.
Add integers on a number line and by the like-sign and unlike-sign rules.
Subtract integers by changing the sign and adding.
Know the sign rules for products and quotients and that division by 0 is impossible.
Know vinculum, parentheses, braces and square brackets and their order.
Simplify expressions with fractions and decimals using BODMAS and solve problems.
Define ratio, antecedent and consequent; compute and reduce ratios and relate ratio to fraction.
Know proportion, extremes and means; find direct and inverse proportion and solve problems.
Convert between percentages, fractions and decimals and solve problems.
Define selling price, cost price, profit, loss, discount and their percentages; solve problems.
Explain algebra as arithmetic with letters; tell statements from open statements; define variables and algebraic expressions.
Identify terms, coefficients, constants, like and unlike terms.
Add, subtract, simplify bracketed expressions and evaluate for given values.
Define an equation and tell it from an expression.
Define and build linear equations in one variable; solve them including fractional and decimal coefficients; solve real-life problems.
Add and subtract line segments; draw right bisectors and perpendiculars with compasses.
Copy, double, bisect and quarter angles; construct angles such as 60, 30, 15, 90, 45, 75, 120, 150 degrees.
Construct triangles from SSS, SAS, ASA and RHS data.
Find perimeter and area of squares and rectangles, and area of paths.
Know altitude; find area of parallelogram, trapezium and triangle.
Identify cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder and cone by faces, edges, vertices.
Find surface area and volume of cube and cuboid and solve problems.
Define data; tell grouped from ungrouped data.
Draw bar graphs and read pie graphs.
Write a set in descriptive, set-builder and tabular form.
Define and find union, intersection and difference; tell disjoint from overlapping sets.
Define universal set and complement; verify set properties.
Show sets and their operations on Venn diagrams for subset, disjoint and overlapping cases.
Define a rational number p/q and show it on the number line.
Add, subtract, multiply and divide rational numbers; find additive and multiplicative inverses and reciprocals.
Verify commutative, associative and distributive properties.
Compare and order rational numbers.
Convert decimals to rational numbers.
Define terminating and recurring decimals and use the denominator rule (only 2 and 5 as prime factors).
Express rational numbers as decimals and round off.
Identify base, exponent and value.
Deduce and use the product, quotient and power laws, zero and negative exponents.

units.title: Unit 5: Square Root of Positive Number

outcomes.text: Define and test perfect squares and use their properties.
Find square roots of perfect-square numbers, fractions and decimals by factorization and division; solve problems.
Define continued ratio; solve direct and inverse proportion problems by unitary and proportion methods.
Solve time and work problems; relate speed, time and distance; convert km/h to m/s; solve variation problems.
Explain property tax and general sales tax and solve tax problems.
Explain profit and markup, find the annual rate and solve problems.
Define zakat and ushr and solve related problems.
Define constants, variables, literals, expressions and polynomials; name monomials, binomials and trinomials.
Add and subtract polynomials; multiply monomials, binomials and trinomials; simplify.
Recognise and verify (x+a)(x+b), (a+b)^2, (a-b)^2 and a^2-b^2.
Factorize using identities and by grouping.
Define a linear equation in one variable and solve ax+b=c and fractional forms; solve real-life problems.
Define adjacent, complementary, supplementary and vertically opposite angles and find unknown angles, including in a triangle.
Identify congruent and similar figures and use the congruency symbol and properties.
Apply SSS, SAS, ASA and RHS congruency of triangles.
Describe circle parts: centre, radius, diameter, chord, arcs, semicircle, segment.
Show the angle in a semicircle is a right angle and angles in the same segment are equal.
Divide a line segment into equal parts or in a given ratio.
Construct triangles from perimeter and side ratio, equilateral triangles, and isosceles triangles.
Construct a parallelogram from adjacent sides with the angle or a diagonal.
Verify practically that angle sums are 180 degrees (triangle) and 360 degrees (quadrilateral).

topics.title: Circumference and area of a circle

subtopics.title: Circumference and area of a circle

outcomes.text: Express pi as circumference over diameter and find circumference and area.
Find surface area and volume of a cylinder and solve problems.
Present data and define frequency, class limits and class interval.
Read and draw pie graphs.
Recognise sets N, W, Z, Q, E, O, P; find subsets, proper and improper subsets and the power set.
Verify commutative, associative and distributive laws for union and intersection; state and verify De Morgan's laws.
Show union and intersection of three overlapping sets and verify associative and distributive laws on Venn diagrams.
Define irrational and real numbers and show non-terminating, non-repeating decimals.
Find perfect squares and patterns of squares.
Find square roots of numbers, fractions and decimals by factorization and division, and of non-perfect squares.
Use the digit-count rule and solve problems.
Recognise cubes, find cube roots of perfect cubes and know cube properties.
Define the base of a number system and explain binary, base 5, octal and decimal.
Convert between decimal and bases 2, 5, 8.
Add, subtract and multiply numbers in these bases.
Define compound proportion and solve problems of partnership and inheritance.
Describe bank accounts, cheques, demand drafts and pay orders.
Explain online banking, ATMs, debit and credit cards.
Convert Pakistani currency; calculate profit/markup, principal, rate and period.
Explain overdraft, running finance, demand finance and leasing.
Find percentage profit, loss and discount, including successive transactions.
Define insurance and solve life and vehicle insurance problems.
Explain income tax, exempt income and taxable income, and solve simple assessee problems.
Recall constants, variables and expressions; define polynomial, degree and coefficients; recognise polynomials by variables and degree.
Add, subtract and multiply polynomials; divide by a linear polynomial.
Recall (a+b)^2, (a-b)^2 and a^2-b^2 and apply them to evaluation and x + 1/x problems.
Factorize by common factors, grouping, perfect squares, difference of squares and a^2 ± 2ab + b^2 - c^2.
Use (a+b)^3 and (a-b)^3 for x^3 ± 1/x^3 problems.
Recognise and form linear equations in two variables; know one pair vs. unique solutions.
Solve by equating coefficients, substitution and cross multiplication; solve real-life problems.
Eliminate a variable by substitution or formulae.
Define parallel lines and their intercept properties.
Show corresponding, alternate, vertically opposite and interior angle relations for a transversal.
Define polygons and show parallelogram properties; define regular pentagon, hexagon and octagon.
Show points inside and outside a circle; describe sector, secant, chord, concyclic points, tangent and concentric circles.
Find and bisect the angle between converging lines without extending them.
Construct squares, rectangles, rhombuses, parallelograms, kites and regular pentagon and hexagon from given data.
Construct a right triangle from hypotenuse and a side or height.
State the Pythagoras theorem, give its informal proof and solve right triangles.
Apply Hero's formula to find areas of triangles and quadrilaterals.
Find surface area and volume of a sphere and a cone and solve problems.
Define demonstrative geometry and basics of reasoning.
Describe axioms, postulates, propositions, theorems, corollaries and converses.
Prove and apply theorems on angles on a line, vertical angles, triangle congruence, isosceles triangles, exterior angles, alternate angles and the 180 degrees angle sum.
Define trigonometry and ratios of acute angles; find ratios for 30, 45 and 60 degrees and complementary angles.
Solve right triangles and height problems.
Define frequency, build a frequency table and a histogram.
Calculate mean, weighted mean, median and mode for ungrouped data and solve problems.
Define a matrix, its rows, columns, order and equality.
Identify row, column, square, zero, identity, scalar, diagonal, transpose, symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices.
Check conformability, add and subtract matrices and multiply by a scalar.
Verify commutative and associative laws; find additive identity and inverse.
Check conformability and multiply matrices; verify associative and distributive laws.
Show AB is not generally BA, define the identity matrix and verify (AB)^t = B^t A^t.

topics.title: Determinant and inverse of a matrix

subtopics.title: Determinant and inverse of a matrix

outcomes.text: Define and evaluate a determinant; tell singular from non-singular matrices.
Find the adjoint and inverse by the adjoint method and verify AA^-1 = I and (AB)^-1 = B^-1 A^-1.
Solve two linear equations in two unknowns by matrix inversion and Cramer's rule, with real-life problems.
Show real numbers as rational and irrational, on the number line and with decimal forms.
Know the properties of real numbers.
Explain radicals and radicands and convert between radical and exponential form.
Apply the laws of exponents with real exponents.
Define a complex number a + ib, its real and imaginary parts, conjugate and equality.
Add, subtract, multiply and divide complex numbers.
Write numbers in scientific notation and back.
Define logarithm, common logarithm, characteristic and mantissa.
Use tables for logarithms and antilogarithms.
Tell common from natural logarithms.
Prove and use the product, quotient, power and change-of-base laws.
Use logarithms to simplify multiplication, division and powers.

units.title: Unit 4: Algebraic Expressions and Algebraic Formulas

outcomes.text: Define rational expressions and tell them from polynomials; reduce to lowest terms.
Add, subtract, multiply and divide rational expressions and evaluate them.
Use (a±b)^2 identities, (a+b+c)^2 and cube formulas to find values of related expressions.
Use a^3 ± b^3 = (a ± b)(a^2 ∓ ab + b^2) for products.
Recognise surds of second order and use operations on them.
Rationalize denominators of the types 1/(a+b√x) and 1/(√x+√y).

Factorize a^4 + a^2b^2 + b^4, x^2+px+q, ax^2+bx+c and four-factor product forms.

State and prove the factor theorem and use it to factorize cubics.

Find the square root of an algebraic expression by factorization and division.
Solve linear equations with rational coefficients and equations with radicals reducible to linear form.
Define absolute value and solve equations involving it.
Define inequalities and their properties: trichotomy, transitive, additive, multiplicative.
Solve linear inequalities with rational coefficients.

units.title: Unit 14: Linear Graphs and Their Application

outcomes.text: Describe the Cartesian plane, axes, origin and plot ordered pairs.
Make value tables and draw graphs of y=c, x=a, y=mx and y=mx+c, choosing scales.

Solve two linear equations graphically.
Derive and use the distance formula.
Define collinear points and test collinearity.
Use distances to show triangles are equilateral, isosceles, right or scalene, and quadrilaterals are squares, rectangles or parallelograms.
Use the mid-point formula and distance formula to verify geometry results.
Prove and use the theorems on congruence: SAA, isosceles-triangle converse, SSS and RHS.

units.title: Unit 19: Line Bisectors and Angle Bisectors

outcomes.text: Prove and apply: points on a right bisector are equidistant from the ends and conversely; right bisectors of a triangle's sides are concurrent.
Prove and apply: points on an angle bisector are equidistant from the arms and conversely; angle bisectors of a triangle are concurrent.

Define and solve joint variation problems.
Use the K-method to prove conditional equalities and solve variation problems.
Define proper, improper and rational fractions.
Resolve fractions with non-repeated and repeated linear factors and non-repeated and repeated quadratic factors.
Recall special sets and perform union, intersection, difference and complement.
Prove and verify commutative, associative, distributive laws and De Morgan's laws.
Show set operations and verify laws using Venn diagrams.

Describe algebraic properties, identities and inverses.

Solve linear systems with complex coefficients.
